title: Transferable Instrument Encounter
architecture_reference: SILT Core v0.2 Semantic Architecture - Freeze Candidate 1 (derived from RC4.1 pre-freeze stress-test revision)
purpose: Test whether SILT can preserve an enduring Obligation while the relational position entitled to performance changes.
pressure_test: Electronic control, transfer, endorsement and possession must not be collapsed into Standing, Authority, ownership or Obligation.

encounter.context: B is current holder of NOTE-001, purports to transfer or endorse it to C, and C Presents the resulting claimed holder Standing in a later encounter.

sources.description: Instrument and relevant transfer relation grounding the holder position.

presentations.purpose: Establish encounter-relevant holder Standing concerning NOTE-001.

obligations.description: A must pay NZD 1000 to the holder of NOTE-001.

conditions.description: B occupies the relevant transferor Standing.
The required transfer or endorsement conditions are satisfied.
C's resulting holder Standing is sufficiently established.
The continuing Obligation survives the holder change unless an expressed condition provides otherwise.

rules: Technical control alone is not sufficient to establish holder Standing unless expressly made sufficient.
Holder change does not by itself extinguish and recreate the underlying Obligation.

expected_evaluations.reason: B occupies the relevant transferor position in the base case.
The base-case transfer or endorsement conditions are met.
C's resulting holder Standing is sufficiently established in the base case.
The underlying Obligation remains outstanding while the entitled position changes.

variants.title: Wrongful technical control
variants.description: C has technical control without a sufficient relational transfer.

expected_evaluations.reason: Technical control alone does not satisfy the holder-Standing condition.

variants.title: Incomplete transfer lineage
variants.description: Necessary evidence concerning the transfer is missing.

expected_evaluations.reason: The supplied state does not establish whether C's holder Standing is operative without importing a missing fact.

variants.title: Revoked agent attempts transfer
variants.description: A technically capable agent attempts the transfer after relevant Authority has been revoked.

must_preserve.statement: Technical execution and semantic Authority remain distinct.

must_not_infer.statement: Successful technical execution must not be treated as proof of Authority.

variants.title: Holder changes, Obligation remains
variants.description: B ceases to be current holder, C becomes current holder, and OBL-01 remains outstanding.

expected_evaluations.reason: The holder change does not itself extinguish or recreate OBL-01.

must_preserve.statement: Technical control is distinct from Standing.
Standing may change without recreating the underlying Obligation.
Evidence is distinct from the Source-grounded relation it supports.

must_not_infer.statement: Wallet or technical control implies holder Standing.
A new holder implies a newly created underlying Obligation.

fixture_verdict: No missing Core primitive exposed by the base case or stated variants.
